threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You know someone’s new when they still look at the bus timetable instead of just trusting that it’ll show up eventually. Classic rookie move.
Last night on the N37, a group of lads dropped a saxophone solo mid-journey. It turned the usual chaos into a makeshift gig—Brixton nights at their best.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When I saw the guy selling homemade empanadas out of a shopping cart while pigeons argued over a discarded doner in front of the canal.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: In Friedrichshain, you'll find spontaneous street parties with DJs and barbecues popping up under the S-Bahn tracks. Feels like summer magic every time!

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: They know to always carry a jacket, even in August. Those who don’t? They're just here for the tech jobs and sunshine.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught a Muni bus at the corner of Larkin and Eddy, and a saxophonist hopped on mid-song, turning the ride into a free concert. Classic SF!

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists often think all the good tapas are in fancy bars, but the best ones are tucked away in tiny shops with just a counter and a smiling abuela.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a newbie by their struggle with the T-10 card machine—just watch them wrestle with it at the metro station.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still stare at the bus timings like they matter, instead of just accepting you'll wait 20 mins in the rain.
Last Saturday, the 196 bus was packed with folks singing old reggae tunes. Even the driver was smiling, but I swear I saw a pigeon trying to join in.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: When the smell of shisha and fresh kebabs became the background of my evening walks, I knew I was home.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: You can find street art galleries behind every corner here, but only in Friedrichshain can you watch a mural transform overnight with just a spray can and some creativity.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You can spot a local by how they know to avoid 24th Street during rush hour once BART’s down. Those just working here are still stuck in traffic.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Watched a bus driver kiss their partner goodbye as passengers boarded, then drive off while still wiping a tear. Only in the TL.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think all of Gràcia is just for selfies, but real life happens in the small plazas after dark, full of laughter and secrets.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by the flock of fresh-faced folks fumbling with the metro map while blocking the escalators near Joanic station. Classic sign!
